from pathlib import Path

original = p.read_bytes()
before, roman_and_body = original.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
edits = {
'Ya abbas ya abbas': 'Ya Abbas ya Abbas',
'Tumhi se aas lagaye udaas baithe hai': 'Tumheṅ se aas lagaaye udaas baithe haiṅ',
'Ye pyase bacche jo zainab ke paas baithe hai': 'Ye pyaase bachche jo Zainab se paas baithe haiṅ',
'Abbas kahaṅ ho abbas kahaṅ ho': 'Abbas kahaaṅ ho Abbas kahaaṅ ho',
'Pani sakina ko pilao': 'Baali Sakina ko pilaao',
'Bolo abbase jari kiuṅ itni dayr hui': 'Bolo Abbas Jari kiuṅ itni der hui',
'Karte hai yaad tumhe phaila ke haath unhe': 'Karte haiṅ yaad mujhe phaila ke haath unheṅ',
'Dekha nahi kab se aa jao ghazi': 'Dekha nahiṅ kab se aa jaao Ghazi',
'La denge pani hame rokega kaun unhe': 'Laa deṅge paani hameṅ rokega unheṅ',
'Ammu bahadur hai mere': 'Ammu bahaadur haiṅ mere',
'Tumko malum hai sab soti hai paas huṅ jab': 'Tum ko maalum hai sab soti hai paas huṅ jab',
'Karte hai ro ro ke dua darya pe ho ae khuda': 'Karte haiṅ ro ro ke dua darya pe ho ae Khuda',
'Parchame abbas utha': 'Parcham-e-Abbas utha',
'Dekho wo aate hai chacha': 'Dekho wo aate haiṅ chaacha',
'Rakh ke shahe diṅ ne kaha': 'Rakh ke Shah-e-Diṅ ne kaha',
'Dekho ae zishan o raza deta hai ta\\'seer sada': 'Dekho ae Zishaan o Raza deta hai taasir sada',
}
words = {
'pani': 'paani', 'pilao': 'pilaao', 'qaimon': 'khaimoṅ', 'qaime': 'khaime',
'ghazi': 'Ghazi', 'bacchoṅ': 'bachchoṅ', 'sakina': 'Sakina', 'abbas': 'Abbas',
'mein': 'meiṅ', 'kooza': 'kuza', 'puchti': 'puchhti', 'chacha': 'chaacha',
'lao': 'laao', 'dikhao': 'dikhaao', 'sambhalo': 'sambhaalo', 'honge': 'hoṅge',
'mashkeeza': 'mashkiza', 'tute': 'tute', 'aao': 'aao', 'nahi': 'nahiṅ',
'seena': 'sina', 'sunao': 'sunaao', 'barhao': 'barhaao', 'masum': 'maasum',
'uthao': 'uthaao', 'bali': 'baali', 'phaynke': 'pheṅke',
'saqqa e haram': 'saqqa-e-haram', 'alamdar': 'Alamdaar',
}
import re
lines = []
for old in roman.splitlines():
    line = old.strip()
    line = edits.get(line, line)
    for word, replacement in words.items():
        line = re.sub(r'(?<"'!'"\\w)' + re.escape(word) + r'(?"'!'"\\w)', replacement, line, flags=re.I)
    for old_phrase, new_phrase in (
        ('uthaye', 'uthaaye'), ('na aaye', 'na aaye'), ('Aa jao', 'Aa jaao'),
        ('Roti hai', 'Roti hai'), ('rahe hai', 'rahe haiṅ'),
    ):
        line = re.sub(r'(?<"'!'"\\w)' + old_phrase + r'(?"'!'"\\w)', new_phrase, line)
    lines.append('  ' + line[0].upper() + line[1:])
new_roman = '\\n'.join(lines)
assert len(lines) == len(body.split()) or len(lines) == len(body.strip().splitlines())
updated = (before + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + new_roman + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode()
assert updated.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
p.write_bytes(updated)
